note: chs 1-6 = narrative scenes; chs 7-12 = apocalyptic vision-units

units.characteristics: the resolved/purposed heart holding conviction with courtesy
units.gist: THE GEM - 'Daniel RESOLVED that he would not defile himself with the king's food'; the purposed heart that draws a line before the pressure comes; conviction held courteously (he ASKS, proposes a TEST, does not defy); God gave him favour; God gave the four learning and skill - the interior decided in advance, quiet and firm

units.characteristics: dependence on God for wisdom; humility about the source; the doxology of trust
units.gist: the king's troubled spirit and impossible demand; Daniel seeks MERCY from the God of heaven concerning the mystery; the doxology 'he reveals DEEP AND HIDDEN THINGS, he knows what is in the DARKNESS, and the light dwells with him'; 'not because of any wisdom that I HAVE' - dependence, humility about the source, worship as the response to revelation

units.characteristics: faith that trusts God's power and submits to his will even without deliverance
units.gist: THE GEM - the fiery furnace: 'our God whom we serve IS ABLE to deliver us... and he WILL deliver us. BUT IF NOT, be it known to you, O king, that we will NOT serve your gods or worship the golden image' - faith holding God's power and God's freedom together, obedience not contingent on rescue; the fourth man in the fire; delivered, not a hair singed

units.characteristics: self-glorying pride humbled; the lifted eyes and returning reason
units.gist: THE GEM - Nebuchadnezzar 'at ease and prospering'; the tree dream; 'is not this GREAT BABYLON which I HAVE BUILT by MY mighty power for the glory of MY majesty?' (self-glorying at the peak); driven to live as a beast; 'at the end of the days I LIFTED MY EYES TO HEAVEN, and my REASON RETURNED... those who walk in PRIDE he is able to HUMBLE' - pride broken, sanity restored with worship

units.characteristics: the heart that will not humble itself though it knew; the interior weighed and found wanting
units.gist: THE GEM - Belshazzar defiling the temple vessels; 'you his son have NOT HUMBLED YOUR HEART, THOUGH YOU KNEW ALL THIS' (refusing the lesson his father learned); 'the God in whose hand is your BREATH... you have not honoured'; the handwriting; 'TEKEL, you have been WEIGHED IN THE BALANCES and found WANTING' - the self measured and short; knowing without humbling

units.characteristics: unwavering devotion under threat; the God served continually
units.gist: THE GEM - Daniel faithful, no fault found; the plot; 'when Daniel knew the document had been signed, he went to his house... and prayed and gave thanks before his God, AS HE HAD DONE PREVIOUSLY' (unchanged by the death-threat, no defiance and no concealment); the lions' den; 'because he had TRUSTED in his God'; the God 'whom you serve CONTINUALLY' - devotion that danger does not alter

units.characteristics: the seer's anxiety at the vision; the matter kept in the heart
units.gist: the four beasts, the Ancient of Days, the son of man given everlasting dominion, the saints receiving the kingdom; 'as for me, Daniel, my SPIRIT WITHIN ME WAS ANXIOUS, and the visions of my head ALARMED me'; 'I KEPT THE MATTER IN MY HEART' - the interior troubled by what it is shown, holding the disturbing revelation inwardly

units.characteristics: the physical cost of the vision; overcome and sick, not understanding
units.gist: the ram and goat, the little horn that grows against the host and 'throws truth to the ground'; Daniel 'FRIGHTENED and fell on my face'; 'I, Daniel, was OVERCOME and lay SICK for some days... I was APPALLED by the vision and DID NOT UNDERSTAND it' - the seer undone bodily by what he sees, left with an un-understood weight (w/ Hab 3:16)

units.characteristics: intercessory confession; identifying with corporate sin; pleading mercy not merit
units.gist: THE GEM - Daniel reads Jeremiah, turns to God 'by prayer and pleas for mercy with fasting and sackcloth'; the great confession 'WE have sinned' (the righteous man identifying with his people's guilt); 'to you belongs righteousness, to us open shame'; 'we do not present our pleas because of OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS but because of YOUR GREAT MERCY'; 'O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive... for your own sake'; 'you are GREATLY LOVED'

units.characteristics: the strengthless self strengthened; greatly loved; the set-and-humbled heart heard from day one
units.gist: THE GEM - Daniel mourning three weeks; the vision of the man in linen; 'NO STRENGTH was left in me'; 'O Daniel, man GREATLY LOVED... FEAR NOT'; 'from the FIRST DAY that you SET YOUR HEART to understand and HUMBLED YOURSELF before your God, your words HAVE BEEN HEARD'; touched and STRENGTHENED three times - the trembling, spent self heartened by being loved and heard

units.characteristics: knowing God as the ground of firmness; stumbling that refines; the self-magnifying king
units.gist: the long war of the kings of north and south (external history); the inner-being gems - 'the people who KNOW THEIR GOD shall STAND FIRM and take action'; 'the WISE shall make many understand, though they STUMBLE... some of the wise shall stumble, SO THAT THEY MAY BE REFINED, purified, and made white'; the king who 'EXALTS HIMSELF and magnifies himself ABOVE EVERY GOD' - knowing God grounds firmness; even the wise's stumbling refines

units.characteristics: the two awakenings; the wise who shine; purification; waiting and rest at the end
units.gist: THE GEM - 'many who sleep in the DUST shall AWAKE, some to everlasting LIFE, some to shame and everlasting CONTEMPT'; 'those who are WISE shall SHINE like the brightness of the sky, and those who turn many to righteousness like the STARS forever'; 'many shall PURIFY themselves and be refined'; 'blessed is he who WAITS'; 'go your way... you shall REST and shall STAND in your allotted place at the end'
